title: APN - Technical Support Services in Support to a DND project located in Eureka
description: Technical Support Services in support to a DND project located in Eureka, Nunavut (with Security Requirements) 1. PURPOSE OF THIS ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform consultants of an upcoming contract opportunity at  Eureka, Nunavut. The purpose of this APN is to allow consultants to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested  consultants to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. 2. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROJECT AND SERVICES It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. APN number: 88283 Approximate Total Potential Estimate: $20,000,000 Anticipated Posting: Winter 2027 Description: The proposed technical support services (TSS) contract will support the project, which aims, among other things, to advance infrastructure planning in the vicinity of Eureka, Nunavut.   The TSS consultant will provide architectural, engineering, and related professional services for Program Formulation and Planning. Services will include but not limited to developing site-specific requirements, validating existing information, completing site-wide infrastructure assessments, preparing developing cost estimates, supporting scheduling, phasing, logistics and sealift planning, identifying risks, and producing planning documentation to support future approvals. Additional services may be added to the contract as requirements are developed. This procurement is anticipated to follow a competitive RFAP, one-step/two-envelope process, including Inuit and Nunavut Benefits Criteria in accordance with the Article 24 Directive. It is anticipated that this solicitation will be initiated in Winter 2027. The total potential estimated value of the consultant services for this program is $20,000,000 This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed by the Department of National Defence (DND). 3. CONTRACT AWARD AND ANTICIPATED SECURITY REQUIREMENTS To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). 4. Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing consultants early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, consultants that intend to submit a  proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number, as identified in Section 2 of this APN; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored, as identified in Section 3 of this APN. 5. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a consultant: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package prior to the closing date indicated in the solicitation, and has submitted a proposal.   DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Note –Consultants that do not submit a  proposal will not be able to attain clearance through this sponsorship process. Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent or tenderer regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. 6. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Priscille Vumi Leader, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada 343-596-6289 priscille.vumi@dcc-cdc.gc.ca 7. Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process  and does not provide any representations  or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

title: Consulting Services for Designated Substances and Hazardous materials
description: QUMATD27, Regional Tool – Consulting Services for the Characterization of Designated Substances and Hazardous Materials Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is calling for abbreviated proposals from consulting firms to award two Standing Offer Agreement (SOAs) to provide “as and when required” the following professional services for the characterization of designated substances and hazardous materials at Quebec region: Locate designated substances and hazardous materials, characterize the materials present in a representative manner, inventory designated substances in the building in question, and make recommendations regarding the handling and disposal of materials containing designated substances or hazardous materials. Information provided by the Proponents will be evaluated using the established criteria in the RFAP. The objective of this RFAP is to select the two (2) proponents with the highest total score. Each SOA will be for a period of one (1) year with a maximum estimated value of $ 500,000 If mutually agreeable between the Consultant and DCC, the SOAs may be extended for up to four (4) additional one-year periods each and increased in the order of $ 500,000 up to four-time, at any time. Call-ups under the SOAs are expected to be valued between $ 500 and $ 25,000; the maximum value of a call-up under SOA is $ 100,000. Refer to the RFAP document for additional information. This solicitation is being conducted in accordance with the requirements set out in the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), Chapter Nineteen of the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) and the World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-GPA). Firms that consider themselves qualified to provide these services are invited to submit their Abbreviated Proposals through the MERX Electronic Bidding System on or before the closing date and time indicated on the Electronic Bidding System. The selected consultants will be required to hold a valid DOS Reliability, issued by the Contract Security Program (CSP) within Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC).  Details concerning the Security Requirements for this project are identified in the RFAP documents. Questions regarding this solicitation are to be directed ONLY to the point of contact identified in this advertisement.  Proponents who address their questions to anyone other than the point of contact during the solicitation period may, for that reason alone, be disqualified. Please note that the preliminary results for this solicitation will be available on MERX. title: Uimaopetuksen hankinta 2027
description: Uimaopetuksen hankinta 2027 Espoon kaupunki (myöhemmin myös Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia uimaopetuksesta. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan sisällöstä on tarjouspyynnön liitteellä 1. "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Sopimus on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Tilaaja valitsee kaksi (2) toimittajaa sekä yhden (1) varatoimittajan. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvo neljälle vuodelle ilman arvonlisäveroa (alv 0 %) on 2 500 000 euroa. Tilaaja ei sitoudu tiettyihin hankintamääriin sopimuskauden aikana. Ennen tarjousten jättöaikaa järjestetään vapaaehtoinen tutustumiskäynti seuraaviin uimahalleihin: Leppävaaran uimahalli Keski-Espoon uimahalli Espoonlahden uimahalli Matinkylän uimahalli Tutustumiskäynti järjestetään viikolla 49. Ilmoittautuminen käynteihin 27.11. mennessä sähköpostitse osoitteeseen: virpi.mikama@espoo.fi. Hankinnan valmistelu Hankintayksikkö on valmistellut hankintaa arvioimalla markkinoilla olevia vaihtoehtoja ja kilpailuolosuhteita sekä hankinnan toteuttamistapoja. Markkinakartoituksessa on kuultu alan toimijoita kirjallisesti ja markkinavuoropuhelun kautta. Markkinakartoitus on toteutettu siten, ettei yksittäistä toimittajaa ole suosittu ja kartoituksessa on toimittu tasapuolisesti ja avoimesti.,

title: Assistant Criminal Analyst (ACA) Services
description: Assistant Criminal Analysts (ACAs) are contemplated as contractor support personnel who would provide administrative, research, data-processing, and analytical assistance to Government Criminal Analysts, criminal investigators, and law-enforcement personnel. Anticipated activities include organizing analytical files; collecting, processing, and evaluating information; preparing draft analytical products; supporting lead development and deconfliction; documenting investigative activity; and preparing materials for Government review and approval. In addition to general ACA support, ICE is considering specialized Criminal Analyst Subject Matter Expert labor categories at the Associate and Principal levels. These categories may include all-source and open-source analysis, financial analysis, international trade and counterproliferation, cryptocurrency and blockchain, screening and vetting, cyber analysis, fraud analysis, data science and artificial intelligence, national security, human trafficking, and child-exploitation investigative analysis.

title: FA8601 Auto Sampler Maintenance and Repair
description: COMBINED SYNOPSIS / SOLICITATION NOTICE: This is a combined synopsis and solicitation (synopsitation hereafter), which is expected to result in award of a Firm Fixed Price blanket purchase agreement for commercial services, i.e. Auto Sampler Maintenance and Repair as described in the Performance Work Statement (Attachment 1). The synopsitation is prepared in accordance with the format in the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 12.202, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; proposals are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. An award, if any, will be made to the responsible offeror who submits a proposal that (1) conforms to the requirements of the synopsitation; (2) receives a rating of Acceptable on the Technical Capability evaluation factor (Attachment 3); and (3) submits the proposal with the lowest total evaluated price (TEP), provided that the TEP is not unbalanced and is fair and reasonable. The Government reserves the right to award without discussions or make no award at all depending upon (1) the quality of proposals received and (2) the price fair and reasonableness of proposals received.- Synopsitation Number: FA860127R0009- NAICS Code: 811210- Small Business Size Standard: $34M- Set-Aside: N/A (Unrestricted / Full and Open)- Synopsitation Closing Date: Proposals must be received not later than 1:00pm Eastern, 7 January 2027.PROPOSAL SUBMISSION: Submit electronic proposals exclusively via the PIEE Solicitation Module at https://piee.eb.mil under solicitation number FA860127R0009. Offerors must be registered in PIEE and possess the Proposal Manager role. Emailed proposals are NOT authorized and will not be evaluated. QUESTIONS AND CORRESPONDENCE: Submit all pre-proposal questions and administrative correspondence via e-mail to: ashley.schneider.2@us.af.mil and edward.huchison@us.af.mil. Any correspondence sent via e-mail must contain the subject line FA860127R0009 Auto Sampler Maintenance and Repair. Do not send proposals via email. Emails shall not exceed 15 megabytes including attachments, if any. E-mails with compressed files are not permitted. Note that e-mail filters at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base are designed to filter e-mails without subject lines or with suspicious subject lines or contents (i.e., .exe or .zip files). Therefore, if the specified subject line is not included, the e-mail may not get through the e-mail filters. Also be advised that .zip or .exe files are not allowable attachments and may be deleted by the email filters at Wright-Patterson. If sending attachments with email, ensure only .pdf, .doc, .docx, .xls or .xlsx documents are sent. The email filter may delete any other form of attachments. Address questions regarding this synopsitation to Ashley Schneider at ashley.schneider.2@us.af.mil. A detailed description of the requirement including a draft contract with line items, delivery schedule, period of performance, inspection and acceptance information, other terms and conditions, provisions and clauses, representations and certifications, specific instructions for submission of proposals, an explanation of how proposals will be evaluated, performance work statement, and wage determinations, are provided in the attached documents. Upon award, any provisions that were in the draft contract (including representations and certifications) will be removed from the award document.

Integrated Design Build Initial Outfitting (iDBIO) Multiple Award Task Order (MATOC) 6.0 Design Build (DB) Construction in Support of Defense Health Agency (DHA)
description: THIS NOTICE IS PROVIDED FOR INFORMATION ONLY: THIS SYNOPSIS IS ONLY A NOTIFICATION A SOLICITATION IS ANTICIPATED AND FORTHCOMING. The anticipated solicitation is associated with the iDBIO MATOC 6.0, W9127S25RA002, W9127S26RA044. The solicitation number has been updated to reflect W9127S27RA018. TITLE: Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple Award Task Order Contracts (MATOC) For Integrated Design-Build Initial Outfitting iDBIO In Support of Military Health System (MHS). DESCRIPTION: THIS ACQUISITION IS FOR FIRM-FIXED PRICE (FFP) INDEFINITE DELIVERY/INDEFINITE QUANTITY (IDIQ) MULTIPLE AWARD TASK ORDER CONTRACTS (MATOC) FOR DESIGN BUILD (DB) CONSTRUCTION. The MHS relies on the support of the Defense Health Agency (DHA) and the US Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) � Little Rock District (CESWL) to execute its health facility program. A means to manage this program is via Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple Award Task Order Contracts (MATOC). Under these contracts, the contractor provides all necessary labor, material, supervision, and equipment for the design, construction, repair/alteration, and outfitting to sustain, restore, and/or modernize hospitals, clinics, medical administration buildings, ambulatory health facilities, medical warehouses, medical labs, biological engineering labs, dental clinics, veterinary clinics, wellness centers, and any other healthcare buildings, using recapitalization funding and processes. The Scope of Work (SOW) for the resultant contracts will primarily be associated with the renovation of existing facilities but may also include major repair and new construction. Work may include mechanical (to include medical gas and plumbing), electrical, fire protection, architectural (to include building envelope), conveying systems, structural (to include antiterrorism/force protection), and civil/site infrastructure. This requirement will be performed within the continental United States (CONUS), Alaska, Hawaii and U.S. Territories (OCONUS). This work is performed in ongoing active healthcare facilities. This acquisition will be a firm-fixed price (FFP), indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity (IDIQ), multiple award task order (MATOC), for design-build construction services. It will be procured using the two- phase design-build selection procedures in accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 36.3. The acquisition is open to both unrestricted and small businesses. A single pool of both unrestricted and small businesses will be established with a shared capacity of $3B. The period of performance will consist of a total ordering period of seven (7) years; five-year base ordering period and a two-year option ordering period. Most projects (task orders) will range between $2M and $90M with an average performance period of 2-3 years. These services include cradle to grave project management services, design services, warehousing capabilities, delivery, installation, inventory, warranty services, commissioning and training on all new equipment/systems. The contractor must also be able to fulfill fast-tracked timelines. Timely completion of upgrades and renovations is paramount to maintaining quality, safe, infection-free facilities. Most projects will involve either multi-phased renovation projects all while maintaining on-going healthcare operations or new construction. DHA Program anticipates around six (6) task orders will be executed annually (not excluding subsequent modifications) so Contractor�s may be required to simultaneously delivery multiple projects at different locations. Projects will be mostly for Air Force clients, but other Federal/Department of Defense clients (such as Army) may also use the contract so familiarity with DOD and AF criteria is required. Using integrated project delivery (IPD) principles and Lean processes, the Contractor�s and their partners/subcontractors will be required to work closely with multiple stakeholders to include users, owner and installation representatives, government subject matter experts, architectural review boards, etc. In accordance with RFO 36.3, Two-Phase Design-Build Selection Procedures, a Two-Phase source selection process will be used to evaluate the Offerors for award. In Phase I, interested firms or joint venture entities (referred to as �Offerors�) may submit certain specified performance proposals, demonstrating their capability to successfully execute the DB contract resulting from this solicitation. The Government will evaluate the performance capability in accordance with the criteria described in the Phase 1 solicitation documents. Those offerors who are considered the most highly qualified during Phase I (a target of three (3) small business and five (5) unrestricted offerors) will be requested to submit the proposal requirements for Phase II. Specific evaluation criteria will be provided in the solicitation documents. In Phase II, the selected Offerors will submit certain specified technical design proposals for an initial task order and a price proposal. The Government will evaluate the Phase II proposals in accordance with the criteria described for Phase II in the solicitation documents, and award to the responsible Offerors, whose proposals conforms with all the terms and conditions of the solicitation and whose proposals are determined to represent the overall best value to the Government. The Government will post the solicitation and all subsequent amendments to the Government-Wide Point of Entry (GPE) SAM.GOV Web Site https://www.sam.gov. It is the Offeror's sole responsibility to obtain this solicitation and any subsequent amendments through this website. Offerors are encouraged to visit this web site and become familiar with its content and functionality prior to the solicitation issue date. Prospective Offerors must provide all information necessary to receive posting notifications. Offerors must be registered and have an active, valid registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) database. To obtain information on CCR, ORCA, & EPLS and/or how to register, visit the following web site: https://www.sam.gov. Estimated solicitation issue date is on or about November 30, 2026, Phase I Proposals are anticipated to be due on or about January 7, 2027. The North American Industry Classification System code for this procurement is 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The US Small Business Administration Size Standard is $45 Million. The Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) Code is 1542 - General Contractors-Nonresidential Buildings, Other than Industrial Buildings and Warehouses. Federal Service Code (FSC Code): Z2DA

title: Strategic Environmental Research and Development Program Core Broad Agency Announcement
description: BOTH SMALL BUSINESS AND LARGE BUSINESS ARE ENCOURAGED TO RESPOND. The Department of War�s (DoWs) Strategic Environmental Research and Development Program (SERDP) is interested in receiving pre-proposals for research focusing in the areas of Environmental Restoration, Resource Conservation and Resilience, and Weapons Systems and Platforms. This notice constitutes a Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) as contemplated in Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (RFO) 6.101(b)(3)(ii)(A). Readers should note that this is an announcement to declare SERDP�s intent to competitively fund research and development for environmental research that addresses the Statements of Need (SON) set forth in the Announcement. SERDP supports research relevant to the management and mission of the DoW and supports efforts that lead to the development and application of innovative technologies or methods that improve the performance of DoW by improving outcomes, managing risks, and/or reducing costs or time required to resolve installation problems. The Program Announcement and complete submittal instructions are found on the DoW SERDP website at https://serdp-estcp.mil/workwithus. To be eligible for consideration, readers wishing to respond to this announcement must submit a pre-proposal in accordance with all instructions on the SERDP website no later than 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time on 7 January 2027. No electronic mail, faxed, or hard copy proposals will be accepted. No other announcement of this opportunity will be made. It is the sole responsibility of the proposer to make certain the proposal is properly received by SERDP. Awards will take the form of contracts. Submission of pre-proposals is not restricted in any way to any particular entity. The Government will not pay for any costs associated with the preparation of proposals or travel to present oral presentations in support of the proposals. There is no commitment by SERDP to make any contract awards, nor to be responsible for any costs incurred by the offeror before contract award is made. It is anticipated that multiple awards totaling approximately $10 million will be made available for projects dependent upon the quality of proposals received and availability of funds. Awardees under this BAA will be selected through a multi-stage review process. The pre-proposal review step allows interested organizations to submit research pre-proposals for Government consideration without incurring the expense of a full proposal. Based upon the pre-proposal evaluation by SERDP, each of the pre-proposal submitters will be notified as to whether SERDP requests or does not request the submission of a full proposal. As noted in the instructions located on the SERDP website, evaluation criteria for pre-proposals are, in decreasing order of importance, Technical Merit, Personnel, and Cost. Due to the anticipated volume of pre-proposals that will be received, SERDP will not provide debriefs on those that are not requested to submit a full proposal. Instructions for preparing a full proposal will be provided at the time of notification. A request for submission of a full proposal does not indicate a decision has been made to make an award for that work. Evaluation criteria for full proposals will include Transition Plan in addition to the criteria above. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 541715 with the small business size standard of 1000 employees. Prior to award, selected contract proposals that exceed $900,000 submitted by all Other than Small (large or non-profits, including universities) Business concerns must be accompanied by a Small Business Subcontracting Plan in accordance with RFO 52.219-9 and elements as described in the checklist in RFO DFARS PGI 219.206-3 at http://business.defense.gov/Acquisition/Subcontracting/Subcontracting-Guide. Selectees who are located outside the United States and outlying areas who will perform their project outside of the United States and outlying areas are exempt from submitting a Small Business Subcontracting Plan. The US Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Mission Support Battalion (UMSB) Small Business Office website at https://www.usace.army.mil/HECSA/HECSA-Small-Business/ provides information on how to prepare a subcontracting plan, along with links to find small businesses to participate. See the attached instructions for additional information regarding Small Business Subcontracting Plans. Additionally, please see the attached template for submitting an Individual Small Business Subcontracting Plan. Points of Contact: Procedural/Technical Questions - SERDP Office 571-372-6565 Contract Questions � UMSB Shannon N. Benson 703-428-7407; shannon.n.benson@usace.army.mil Small Business Participation or Subcontracting Plan - UMSB Small Business Representative Monique Holmes 202-934-1816, HECSASmallBusinessProgram@usace.army.mil

title: Raystown Lake "Timberdoodle" Timber Sale
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers is offering for sale one (1) item. Item 1 of timber is on approximately 162 acres named the Timberdoodle Timber Sale. Item one (1) of this sale is located on Raystown Lake Project in Hopewell Township, Huntingdon County, Pennsylvania. The sale area consists of three () harvest blocks which total forty-eight (162) acres. Even-age management practices of shelterwood and clearcut removal have been prescribed for implementation. The primary sawtimber species composition of designated timber consists of chestnut oak, northern red oak, yellow-poplar, and red maple. Previously used haul roads, log landings, and skid trails exist therefore site impacts with respect to new construction will be minimal. Whole tree chipping IS NOT permitted, treetops must remain onsite. An Erosion and Sedimentation Plan and Accident Prevention Plan, including First Aid/CPR certification for each onsite worker, shall be provided by the Purchaser and approved by the Government prior to the start of timber harvesting. In addition, Proof of Pennsylvania SFI� Professional Timber Harvester Training Program for the onsite logging crew lead shall be provided by the Purchaser and approved by the Government prior to the start of timber harvesting. HARDWOOD SAWTIMBER: 454,611 BF (1/4") International HARDWOOD PULPWOOD: 4,297 Tons of pulpwood on approximately 162 acres. The timber to be sold may be inspected by prospective purchasers. A formal pre-bid tour is scheduled only on Thursday 17 December 2026 please schedule with Project Forester, Glenn Werner or Chief District Forester Andrew Willey. Sealed bids will be accepted until 2:00 p.m. Thursday 7 January 2027, by the Acquisition, Management, and Disposal Section, Real Estate Office, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, 803 Front Street, Norfolk, Virginia 23510-1011, and then publicly opened. Forms for use in submitting bids are attached to this post you will find and Invitation For Bid as a pdf file. This pdf file contains the terms and conditions of the sale, the procedure for submitting bids, and description of the timber all of which are contained in the attached Invitation for Bid. **Always look for the most recent attached pdf as updates can be made to the invitation for bid should corrections be made or more information becomes available.** Interested parties may reach either Mr. Andrew Willey for questions pertaining to bidding or the contract by cell phone at (757) 516-3538 or for questions pertaining to the timber or arranging attendance to the timber sale area viewing please contact Mr. Glenn Werner at (814) 658-6807 or (814) 386-1995 prior to the date and time of bid opening. It is suggested to contact the individuals listed above prior to the pre-bid tour and the again prior to the week of bid opening with any pertinent questions. **Important please ensure all instructions for bidding are followed, ensure that your bid makes it to the appropriate location ON TIME, mail it early if in doubt.**

title: Utilities Privatization of the Water System at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii (USAG-HI), Island of Oahu
description: DLA Energy, in conjunction with the United States Army, plans to offer the privatization of the Water distribution (NAICS 221310) utility system at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii, Island of Oahu. Utilities Privatization (UP) is defined as the transfer of ownership and responsibility to a municipal, private, regional, district, or cooperative utility company or other entity, for the operations, maintenance, repair, future upgrades, and future utility systems replacements. The conveyance may consist of all right, title, and interest of the United States in the utility system. UP will be accomplished in accordance with 10 U.S.C. �2688 � Utility Systems: Conveyance Authority. As a result of this solicitation, the Contractor(s) will be selected to assume ownership of the Water utility system. The new owner(s) shall operate and maintain the system and provide utility services to the Government. Any resulting contract, if awarded, will require the Contractor to furnish all facilities, labor, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to own, maintain, and operate the utility system. All responsibility for maintaining reliable service, including such items as environmental compliance, maintenance costs, major system renovations, construction, equipment, manpower, and overhead costs shall become the utility system owner�s responsibility. The Contractor shall manage the maintenance, repairs, replacement, etc., of the system to ensure continuous, adequate, and dependable service for each Government or tenant connection within the service area. The Contractor shall be responsible for funding all capital investments required to acquire, maintain, and operate the utility system in a safe, reliable condition and to meet the requirements listed in the contract. Real property interests will be conveyed in the form of a Right to Access or an Easement as a reference to the resultant contract. The utility system will be conveyed via a Bill of Sale after a transition period to be determined by the Contractor. Past performance information from potential offerors shall be submitted as directed in the solicitation. A Sources Sought Notice for this requirement was previously publicized under solicitation number SP060026R0813 on May 29, 2026. The Sources Sought Notice has closed and market research is complete. This requirement will be unrestricted. All responsible sources are encouraged to submit an offer. Other-than-small businesses are required to submit a subcontracting plan with their offer. Interested sources may contact Jonathan Moore, Contracting Officer at jonathan.moore@dla.mil, Timothy Stark, Contracting Officer at timothy.1.stark@dla.mil, Kathryn Bowman, Contract Specialist at kathryn.bowman@dla.mil, and Lexy Sweitzer, Contract Specialist, at lexy.sweitzer@dla.mil to be added to our offeror mailing list. Secure Documents As this requirement will be an unrestricted, competitive action, several of the solicitation documents will be posted as �secured� on the SAM.gov Contract Opportunities website. In order to view those documents, vendors will need to obtain special access. The process of obtaining access is somewhat lengthy, therefore all interested vendors are encouraged to begin that process as soon as possible. Instructions for obtaining access are provided below. Should any party have issues with obtaining access to SAM.gov or the secure documents, they must notify the contracting office no later than September 29, 2026. Notifications to the contracting office of the inability to access secure documents after that suspense will not be a consideration in extensions to the Request for Proposal date. To ensure all parties are able to retrieve secure documents for this solicitation, a test document has been placed under secure package: SP060026R0813. Instructions for access to the Contract Opportunities Controlled Site To access the controlled, but unclassified, documents in the SAM.gov system, Offerors are required to be registered in SAM.gov. A CAGE Code and Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) are created through the SAM.gov registration process at https://sam.gov/. Offerors must create a login.gov account in SAM.gov. Instructions are below. For additional help, contact the Federal Service Desk at www.fsd.gov or toll free at 1.866.606.8220. To link to an existing login.gov account From https://sam.gov/ go to sign in on the toolbar. Enter an email address and password for the existing login.gov account. Offerors will then receive an email to associate the existing login.gov account with SAM.gov. Offerors will now use this login.gov account to sign into SAM.gov. New users will be asked to complete their SAM.gov profile. title: Utilities Privatization of the Water System at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii (USAG-HI), Island of Oahu
description: DLA Energy, in conjunction with the United States Army, plans to offer the privatization of the Water distribution (NAICS 221310) utility system at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii, Island of Oahu. Utilities Privatization (UP) is defined as the transfer of ownership and responsibility to a municipal, private, regional, district, or cooperative utility company or other entity, for the operations, maintenance, repair, future upgrades, and future utility systems replacements. The conveyance may consist of all right, title, and interest of the United States in the utility system. UP will be accomplished in accordance with 10 U.S.C. �2688 � Utility Systems: Conveyance Authority. As a result of this solicitation, the Contractor(s) will be selected to assume ownership of the Water utility system. The new owner(s) shall operate and maintain the system and provide utility services to the Government. Any resulting contract, if awarded, will require the Contractor to furnish all facilities, labor, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to own, maintain, and operate the utility system. All responsibility for maintaining reliable service, including such items as environmental compliance, maintenance costs, major system renovations, construction, equipment, manpower, and overhead costs shall become the utility system owner�s responsibility. The Contractor shall manage the maintenance, repairs, replacement, etc., of the system to ensure continuous, adequate, and dependable service for each Government or tenant connection within the service area. Real property interests will be conveyed in the form of a Right to Access or an Easement as a reference to the resultant contract. The utility system will be conveyed via a Bill of Sale after a transition period to be determined by the Contractor. title: Material Handling and Storage Aid Systems at JB Lindsey Graham, SC
description: This requirement is for a mechanized materials handling system (MMHS)/storage aid system for Buildings 506 and 543, at Joint Base Lindsey Graham, South Carolina. The project encompasses the design, fabrication, installation, orientation, and testing of a storage aid system within the buildings. All work shall be performed in accordance the Cover Purchase Description (PD) document, including Appendices A-H, and Air Force (AF) Drawings BCH602-01, BCH602-02, BCH602-03 and BCH602-04. The contractor shall provide all equipment, materials, and labor necessary for the complete installation and testing of the MMHS. This includes making any required system adjustments and providing orientation to Government personnel. The contractor shall comply with all applicable laws, regulations, local zoning and permitting requirements, and referenced governmental guidance documents as specified in the PD document and appendices. The Mechanized Materials Handling System will consist of the following major components: Gantry Crane System, Manual Gravity Roller Conveyor, Expandable Roller Conveyor, Mobile Aisle - 1, Mobile Aisle - 2, Mobile Aisle - 3, Bin Shelving, Pallet Racks Type P1 through P7, Steel Decking, all types and Rolling Safety Ladders.

Mercury contamination of the material will be cause for rejection. If the inclusion of metallic mercury is required as a functional part of the material furnished under this contract, the Contractor shall obtain written approval from the Procurement Contracting Officer before proceeding with manufacture. The contractor's request shall explain in detail the requirements for mercury, identify specifically the parts to contain mercury, and explain the method of protection against mercury escape. Such a request will be forwarded directly to the Procurement Contracting Officer with a copy to the applicable Government Inspector. Upon approval by the Contracting Officer, the vendor will provide a "Warning Plate" stating that metallic mercury is a functional part of the item and will include name and location of that part. The use of mercury, mercury compounds, or mercury-bearing instruments and/or equipment in a manner which might cause contamination in the manufacture, assembly, or test of material on this contract is prohibited. The most probable causes of contamination are direct-connected manometers, mercury vacuum pumps, mercury seals, or the handling of mercury in the immediate vicinity. Mercury switches, mercury in glass thermometers, standard cells and other items containing mercury may be used if they are located so as not to constitute a contamination hazard. If external contamination by metallic mercury occurs or is suspected, the following test may be used to determine whether contamination by metallic mercury exists or whether corrective cleaning measures have been effective. Enclose the equipment in a polyethylene bag or close-fitting airtight container for eight hours at room temperature (70 degrees F minimum).Sample the trapped air and if mercury vapor concentration is 0.01 mg/cu meter or more, the material is mercury contaminated insofar as the requirements of this contract are concerned. These requirements shall be included in any subcontract or purchase order hereunder and the Contractor shall insure SubContractor compliance with these requirements. Technical questions pertaining to these requirements shall be referred to the Procurement Contracting Officer via the cognizant Administrative Contracting Officer. For background, the following information is provided: Mercury is corrosive to gold, silver, nickel, stainless steels, aluminum and copper alloys. Stainless steels, nickel, and copper alloys are widely used in reactor plants and other submarine/surface ship systems. Accidental trapping of mercury in a component could cause serious damage to vital parts. Mercury is also toxic if inhaled, ingested, or absorbed through the skin. It is evident that grave consequences could result from small amounts of mercury vapor present in an unreplenished submarine/surface ship atmosphere. 4. The electronic annual representations and certifications are effective for one year from the date of initial submission and expire on an annual basis from the update to SAM.PROJECT DESCRIPTION: This MATOC will consist of fabrication, refurbishment, and installation scope and the preponderance of the requirements for this MATOC is the fabrication and refurbishment of items. FABRICATION METHODS: The Contractor will be required to provide and deliver new metal castings, forgings or built-up steel components; heat treated steel components; stress relieved components; stainless steel overlays, hard chrome overlays, various types of bushings and bearings; precise milling, turning, grinding, planning, slotting, and other machine work; and pressure vessel manufacturing and certification. With technological advances, use of composite materials like FRP or use of additive manufacturing techniques such as WAAM may be requested. Contractor shall be capable of supplying and delivering new or refurbished existing hydraulic cylinders, strut arm spring assemblies; structural steel or aluminum fabrication; welding and bolting of structural steels, castings, and forgings; galvanized coating, vinyl painting or other approved coating systems; and other operations that are necessary to provide complete products or parts that are necessary to the operation of the locks, dams and facilities of the Districts located in the Great Lakes and Ohio River Division. At a minimum, the fabrication facility must be large enough to fabricate 110 wide bulkheads, miter gates up to 75ft x 65 ft, and 110 wide Tainter gates indoors and as a complete unit. The fabrication facility must also be capable of fabricating bulk machining, casting and forging of parts that are ancillary to the larger structural steel item. The Contractor must provide secure and appropriate ventilated storage area for short-term storage of fabricated item(s) as required per Delivery Order. INSTALLATION: Installation of the above-mentioned fabricated components may include but is not limited to the utilization of marine equipment, land-based cranes and floating cranes to access the lock and dam, floating risk management facilities, and other facilities. Fabrications may be very large and must be installed to close tolerances. Installation work may require refurbishment and/or removal and disposal of existing structures. Installation may also require removal of associated components, operating equipment, or structures to install fabricated parts, and subsequent replacement of those removed parts. Installation will be completed by skilled trades and will be subject to wage rates identified per Delivery Order, when applicable. Delivery Orders with installation scope may contain incidental construction and respective clauses, as applicable. BASIS FOR AWARD: In accordance with RFO 15.104(b)(1)(ii), the Government intends to award a contract to each and all qualifying Offerors. A qualifying Offeror is an Offeror that is determined to be a responsible source [in accordance with RFO Subpart 9.1, Responsible Prospective Contractors], submits a technically acceptable proposal that conforms to the requirements of the solicitation, and the Contracting Officer has no reason to believe the Offeror would be likely to offer other than fair and reasonable pricing. RFO 15.104(b)(1)(ii) permits Contracting Officers to evaluate cost or price only at the delivery order levels, if the multiple-award contract under which the orders are being placed are for the same or similar services and a contract award was made to each and all qualifying Offerors. The Contracting Officer has confidence the Government will receive fair and reasonable pricing at the delivery order level. The award will be made based on the appropriate consideration given to the two (2) evaluation Factors: (1) Capacity and Capability and (2) Past Performance. To receive consideration for award, a rating of Acceptable must be achieved in both Factors. The source selection process will be conducted in accordance with RFO Subpart 15.2, Evaluation and Award, and supplements. Offers will be evaluated using the criteria listed below. Noncompliance with the RFP requirements may raise serious questions regarding an Offerors technical capability or past performance and may be grounds to eliminate the proposal from consideration for contract award. Failure to include all information requested may adversely affect the evaluation. A proposal that merely reiterates or promises to accomplish the requirements of the RFP will be considered unacceptable. A proposal that is orderly and sufficiently documented will be easy for the Government to understand and will enable the Government to perform a thorough and fair evaluation.

title: Germany – Electrical wiring and fitting work – Los 401 Elektroinstallation - Ensemble Goethe-Wohnhaus: Denkmalgerechte Instandsetzung
description: Gegenstand der Gesamtmaßnahme ist die umfassende elektrotechnische Sanierung der Stark- und Schwachstromanlagen des Goethewohnhauses einschließlich der zugehörigen Nebengebäude sowie der Außenanlagen. Die Maßnahme umfasst die vollständige bzw. teilweise Erneuerung, Erweiterung und Anpassung der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unter Berücksichtigung der denkmalpflegerischen Anforderungen, der vorhandenen baulichen Gegebenheiten sowie der bestehenden technischen Anlagen. Hierzu gehören insbesondere die Energieversorgung und Elektroinstallation, Haupt- und Unterverteilungen, Erdungs- und Potentialausgleichsanlagen, Sicherheitsbeleuchtungsanlagen, allgemeine Beleuchtungsanlagen, Datennetzinfrastruktur sowie sicherheitstechnische Anlagen einschließlich Brandmelde- und Einbruchmeldeanlagen. Die Gesamtmaßnahme ist räumlich in drei Teil-Lose gegliedert, welche jeweils einen baulich und funktional abgegrenzten Leistungsbereich umfassen: - 401.0: Hauptprojekt – Substanzerhalt - Goethewohnhaus, Vulpiushäuser und Torhaus einschließlich der erforderlichen Schnittstellen zu den Bestandsanlagen. - 401.1: Teilprojekt 1 - Steinpavillon und Gartenpavillon. - 401.2: Teilprojekt 2 - Außenanlagen Geplante Leistungen: - Rückbau, Demontage und fachgerechte Entsorgung vorhandener elektrischer Anlagen und Installationen. - Neuerrichtung Niederspannungshauptverteilung (NSHV) inkl. der erforderlichen Einspeisungen, Schalt- und Schutzgeräte u. der Abgangs- und Überwachungseinrichtungen - Neuerrichtung 12 Niederspannungs-Unterverteilungen inkl. der zugehörigen Zuleitungen, Schaltgeräte, Schutzorgane u. Stromkreisabgänge - Ertüchtigung u. Anpassung von 4 bestehenden Unterverteilungen inkl. erford. Umbau-, Erweiterungs- und Anpassungsarbeiten. - Erneuerung u. Anpassung der Energieversorgungs- und Stromkreisinstallationen inkl. sämtlicher erford. Zuleitungen und Abgänge. - Herstellung u. Anpassung der Erdungs- u. Potentialausgleichsanlagen. - Installation und Inbetriebnahme von Beleuchtungsanlagen inkl. erford.Steuerungs- und Schalttechnik. - Installation u. Erneuerung von Sicherheitsbeleuchtungsanlagen. - Aufbau und Erweiterung der strukturierten Datennetzinfrastruktur inkl. Datenleitungen, Anschlusstechnik u. erford. Verteilerkomponenten. - Neuerrichtung Brandmeldeanlage (BMA) inkl. neue Brandmeldezentrale u. erford. Melder, Alarmierungseinrichtungen, Schnittstellen u. Übertragungseinrichtungen. - Austausch u. Ertüchtigung der bestehenden Einbruchmeldeanlage (EMA) inkl. Erneuerung bzw. Anpassung Einbruchmeldezentrale u. der erforderlichen Melder, Bedieneinrichtungen, Überwachungseinrichtungen und Anlagenschnittstellen. - Herstellung sämtlicher erforderlicher Leitungswege, Kabeltrassen, Installationskanäle und Befestigungssysteme. - Kernbohrungen, Durchbrüche, Schlitzarbeiten und sonst. baul. Eingriffe für die Leitungsführung. - Fachgerechte brandschutztechnische Abschottungen einschließlich Dokumentation. - Herstellung und Koordination der gebäudeübergreifenden Versorgungs- und Anlagenschnittstellen zwischen den einzelnen Gebäuden und Außenanlagen. - Prüfung, Inbetriebnahme, Dokumentation sämtlicher erneuerter und neu errichteter elektrotechnischer Anlagen. Voraussichtlicher Installations- und Leitungsumfang (Mengen über alle drei Teil-Lose): - 1 Stück, neue Niederspannungshauptverteilung (NSHV) - 12 Stück, neue Niederspannungs-Unterverteilungen - 4 Stück, Ertüchtigung bestehende Unterverteilungen - 1 Anlage, neue Brandmeldeanlage einschließlich Brandmeldezentrale - 1 Anlage, Austausch und Ertüchtigung Einbruchmeldeanlage einschließlich Zentrale - ca. 10.000 m Energie- u. Installationskabel NYY/NYM, Querschnitte ca. 3 × 1,5 mm² bis 5 × 2,5 mm² - ca. 15.000 m Datenleitungen für strukturierte Datennetzinfrastruktur - ca. 2.000 m Brandmeldekabel für Brandmeldeanlagen - ca. 1.000 m Leitungen für Einbruchmeldeanlagen (EMA)

title: Germany – Underwear – Lieferung von Wollunterwäsche
description: Dem LZN obliegt die Beschaffung von Waren und Dienstleistungen für die unmittelbare niedersächsische Landesverwaltung (vgl. § 2 der Betriebsanweisung des LZN). Mit Zustimmung seiner Aufsichtsbehörde kann das LZN weitere Aufgaben für öffentlich-rechtliche Bedarfsträger innerhalb und außerhalb der niedersächsischen Landesverwaltung sowie für privatrechtliche Gesellschaften in vollständiger Eigentümerschaft der öffentlichen Hand übernehmen (vgl. § 3 Betriebsanweisung). In dieser Zuständigkeit umfasst der Auftrag den Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung mit einem Unternehmen (§ 21 VgV) über die Lieferung von Wollunterwäsche für die Kooperationspartner der norddeutschen Küstenländer der Polizei und Justiz, der Landesforsten und Ordnungsämtern innerhalb von Deutschland und sonstige Behörden (gemäß Anlage) mit einer Preisbindung von 24 Monaten sowie optional zwei einseitige Vertragsverlängerungen zu jeweils höchstens 12 Monaten mit einem Unternehmen. Nähere Einzelheiten zu Art und Umfang des Auftrags sind der Leistungsbeschreibung -Technischer Teil (Teil B) inkl. Angebotsvordruck zu entnehmen. Nähere Einzelheiten zu Art und Umfang des Auftrags sind den technischen Lieferbedingungen und dem Angebotsvordruck zu entnehmen.

title: Germany – Transmission apparatus for radiotelephony, radiotelegraphy, radio broadcasting and television – Aufbau und Erneuerung Sport Campus
description: Auf Beschluss der ARD soll der ARD-SportHub zentral beim WDR in Köln etabliert werden. Ziel des Projekts ist die schrittweise Errichtung einer zukunftsweisenden, crossmedialen Produktionsumgebung für Sportformate. Der Fokus liegt auf der Optimierung redaktioneller, produktions-technischer und infrastruktureller Arbeitsbedingungen sowie der Einführung moderner, Medien-over-IP-basierter Produktionstechnologien. Bereits seit Januar 2025 produziert der WDR alle Sportgroßereignisse für die gesamte ARD, jeweils unter Federführung der zuständigen Landesrundfunkanstalt (LRA). Die neuen Produktionsräume werden in Köln im Gebäude Arkaden, 3.OG, aufgebaut. Der Auftragsgegenstand umfasst neben einer FS-Regie u.a. diverse Multifunktions-räume, einen Dispatcherraum, zwei Hörfunkregien inkl. Studios, ein Podcaststudio und mehrere OffTube Kabinen. Weiterhin ist Bestandteil dieser Ausschreibung die Errichtung von bis zu 50 redaktionellen Arbeitsplätzen in diversen Büros und auf offenen Flächen. Der 2015 in Betrieb genommene Sport Campus im Gebäude Arkaden, 2.OG, bietet aktuell den Platz für alle an den Herstellungsprozessen der WDR-Sportproduktionen beteiligten Fachbereiche (Redaktion, Produktion und Technik). Der vorhandene Raum besteht aus einer großen Open-Space-Fläche mit daran angeschlossenen redaktionellen Arbeitsplätzen, Konferenzräumen und technisch ausgestatteten Produktionseinheiten auf Basis klassischer Broadcasttechnik. Von dort aus werden alle relevanten Ausspielwege, insbesondere für die "Sportschau", "Sportschau.de" und deren Social-Media-Kanälen bedient. Das Herzstück wird die neue Sport Campus Regie auf Basis einer Live-IP-Infrastruktur bilden, die neben ihrer bestehenden Anbindung zur Presenterfläche im Open-Space-Bereich des Sport Campus zusätzlich auf die Studioflächen in der Rechtschule zugreifen soll, um kleinere Produktionen aus der Sportschau-Deko oder aus der Greenbox abzuwickeln. Die weiteren Produktionseinheiten des Sport Campus werden technisch an die neuen Multifunktionsräume im 3.OG angeglichen.

title: Luxembourg – Financial consultancy, financial transaction processing and clearing-house services – CFT- 1857 Multiple Framework Agreement for the Administration of Financial Products and Services in the EIB Operations Directorate
description: In the context of the evolving complexity of the EIB’s lending activities, the Operations Directorate requires flexible and specialised external support to ensure the effective administration, deployment and continuous improvement of financial products. These services are required to support various departments within the EIB Operations Directorate in maintaining high standards of operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and sound governance of lending products, including conducting assessments or analyses, technical and functional studies, monitoring, testing and advisory outputs in response to business needs. The objective of this Call for Tenders is to award a Framework Agreement for each of the following lots: Lot 1 –Deployment of Financial Products, with up to three operators in cascade Provision of consultancy services to ensure the effective deployment of financial products throughout the investment lifecycle, including the set-up and operational management of financial products, and the adequate execution and consistent application of procedural requirements. Lot 2 – Strategic and Operational support for the Investment Activities, with up to 5 successful tenderers with reopening of competition. Provision of consultancy services to support the strategic development, governance and transformation of the EIB’s investment activities and financial products across their lifecycle. The detailed description of the required services is provided in Annex A – Technical Specifications and its appendices. The Services shall be provided in compliance with the requirements set out by the EIB in Annex A.

title: Norway – Electrical services – Framework agreement electrician services - Notodden municipality and Krødsherad municipality
description: The framework agreement is for the execution of electrical work for all of the contracting authority ́s buildings, sites and infrastructure for technical operations and maintenance with the accompanying materials. Electrical work means, among other things, work related to alterations, extensions, additions, installations, ongoing inspections/service, alterations and maintenance works of the existing buildings, both internally and externally. Prepare proposals for systems and carry out minor engineering design work. The agreement preferably applies for work/assignments that are practical to carry out on an hourly basis, but can also be used for work in connection with new buildings and renovation. The framework agreement also includes the procurement of electrical material. The Contracting Authority is free to trade products from other suppliers in areas where we have other framework agreements. The contract ́s total value is estimated to NOK 4,000,000 excluding VAT per annum. The estimated annual procurements is based on previous history and it is based on a judgemental estimate. The estimate must not be seen as binding for procurements under the framework agreement. The procurement of electrician services will vary from year to year in accordance with the contracting authority ́s needs. Maximum value, including any options and expected price rise: NOK 25,000,000 excluding VAT. The contract will be valid for 2 years from when the contract is signed, with an option for the contracting authority for a further extension for up to 2 years, with 1 year at a time (2+1+1). See the requirement specifications for a comprehensive description of the delivery.

title: Norway – Propane gas – R0013EBE - Framework agreement for the purchase of gas
description: The objective of the framework agreement is to cover Bergen municipality, c/o the Agency for Buildings and Property (EBE) ́s need for the delivery of propane gas to municipal properties, with propane installations as the main source for heating. The framework agreement will be signed with one tenderer and comprises three nursing homes: Fyllingsdalen nursing home, Ulset nursing home and Åstveit nursing home. The supplier monitors the tank levels with the help of the existing automatic level meters and ensures refills, so that the properties always have enough propane gas for normal operation. Transport and other services that are necessary for secure and reliable delivery are included in the contract. The contracting authority has the option to include further municipal properties with propane installations during the agreement period. The procurement is a pure goods delivery and the tenders are only evaluated on price. See the contracting authority ́s specifications.

title: Norway – Construction work – Project 1250901 AHO - Ventilation and ENVIRONMENTAL, windows and roofing work K201 Turnkey contract.

title: Switzerland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Bauherrenvertretung & Projektsteuerung neuer Hauptsitz SZU / neue Instandhaltungsanlage
description: DE: Die bestehende Instandhaltungsanlage am Standort Giesshübel in Zürich ist technisch und betrieblich überholt und erfüllt die zukünftigen Anforderungen an modernes Rollmaterial nicht mehr. Vorgesehen ist der Rückbau der bestehenden Anlage und der Neubau einer zukunftsfähigen Instandhaltungsanlage mit zwei rund 130 m langen Gleisen und Waschanlage. Das Projekt befindet sich in einem innerstädtischen, räumlich stark begrenzten Umfeld mit komplexen Rahmenbedingungen. Gesucht wird eine erfahrene Projektsteuerung / Bauherrenvertretung zur ganzheitlichen Führung des Projekts und optimalen Begleitung dieses vielseitigen komplexen Projektes. Ziel der Beschaffung ist die Beauftragung einer erfahrenen Projektsteuerung / Bauherrenvertretung, welche den Bauherrn bei der Planung und Realisierung der neuen Instandhaltungsanlage ganzheitlich unterstützt und eine zielgerichtete Steuerung von Kosten, Terminen, Qualität und Risiken sicherstellt. Weitere Details zum genauen Umfang entnehmen Sie dem Dokument B1_Lastenheft. FR: L’installation de maintenance existante sur le site de Giesshübel à Zurich est devenue obsolète tant sur le plan technique qu’opérationnel et ne répond plus aux exigences futures du matériel roulant moderne. Le projet prévoit le démantèlement de l’installation existante et la construction d’une nouvelle installation de maintenance pérenne et adaptée aux besoins futurs, comprenant deux voies ferrées d’environ 130 mètres de long ainsi qu’une installation de lavage. Le projet s’inscrit dans un environnement urbain dense, caractérisé par un espace fortement limité et des conditions-cadres complexes. Nous recherchons une équipe expérimentée en gestion de projet / représentation du maître d’ouvrage, capable d’assurer la conduite globale du projet et d’accompagner de manière optimale sa réalisation, compte tenu de sa diversité et de sa complexité. L’objectif du présent marché est de mandater un prestataire expérimenté en gestion de projet / représentation du maître d’ouvrage, chargé d’assister le maître d’ouvrage de manière globale lors de la planification et de la réalisation de la nouvelle installation de maintenance, tout en garantissant un pilotage efficace des coûts, des délais, de la qualité et des risques. Pour plus de détails concernant l’étendue exacte des prestations, veuillez vous référer au document B1_Lastenheft. ENG: The existing maintenance facility at the Giesshübel site in Zurich has become technically and operationally obsolete and no longer meets the future requirements of modern rolling stock. The project the dismantling of the existing facility and the construction of a new, future-proof maintenance facility comprising two railway tracks, each approximately 130 metres long, as well as a washing facility. The project is situated in a densely built-up urban environment with severely limited space and complex boundary conditions. We are seeking an experienced project management / client representation team to provide overall project leadership and ensure optimal support throughout this multifaceted and complex project. The objective of this procurement is to appoint an experienced project management / client representation provider to offer comprehensive support to the client throughout the planning and implementation of the new maintenance facility, ensuring effective management and control of costs, schedules, quality and risks. description: La Communauté de Communes Retz-en-Vallois (ci-après la « CCRV ») est l’autorité organisatrice de la mobilité sur son périmètre, comprenant 54 communes. Elle dispose d’un réseau de transport important (réseau Villéo-Retzéo) pour une intercommunalité de cette strate, constitué des services suivants : - - 4 lignes de transport régulier : o 3 lignes de transport régulier (Lignes A, B et C) parcourant la commune de Villers-Cotterêts ; o 1 ligne de transport régulier (Ligne D) reliant la commune de La Ferté-Milon à Villers-Cotterêts. 1 service de transport à la demande (TAD) desservant 3 zones distinctes : o 1 TAD zonal desservant la commune de Villers-Cotterêts (2 zones existantes) ; o 1 TAD zonal desservant la commune de La Ferté-Milon ; o 1 TAD zonal desservant la commune de Vic-sur-Aisne (2 zones existantes). Au-delà du service proposé par la CCRV, deux autres zones présentent des caractéristiques distinctes en matière de service de transport collectif : - - 1 service de TAD géré par le Syndicat Intercommunal des Transports Urbains Soissonnais (ci-après « SITUS »). Ce service mis en œuvre dans le cadre d’une convention SITUS/CCRV dessert 5 communes membres de la CCRV afin de permettre les déplacements vers la commune de Soissons (réseau Flexi’TUS). 7 communes de la CCRV (Ambleny, Bieuxy, Cutry, Epagny, Laversine, Nouvron-Vingré, Vézaponin) faisaient partie d’un programme d’expérimentation de lignes TAD exploitées par le SITUS vers la commune de Soissons. L’expérimentation de ces lignes de TAD n’a pas été prolongée et le service a été arrêté le 1er juillet 2025. Ces 7 communes n’ont donc, actuellement, aucun service de transport proposé, que ce soit par la CCRV ou par le SITUS. Le réseau exploité par la CCRV comprenant les 4 lignes de transport régulier ainsi que les services de TAD (hors SITUS) susvisées, est actuellement exploité dans le cadre d’une concession de type délégation de service public arrivant à échéance au 31 août 2027. La présente consultation (ci-après « la Consultation ») a pour objet de confier, par un contrat de délégation de service public (ci-après « le Contrat ») l’exploitation des services publics de mobilités présentés ci-dessus à un délégataire de service public.

Szczegółowy opis przedmiotu zamówienia stanowi załącznik nr 1.4 do SWZ Formularz asortymentowo-cenowy. 2. Realizacja przedmiotu zamówienia odbywać się będzie w formie sukcesywnych dostaw, na podstawie zamówień jednostkowych składanych przez Zamawiającego w okresie obowiązywania umowy. Wykonawca zobowiązany będzie do realizacji każdej dostawy w terminie zadeklarowanym w ofercie, nie dłuższym jednak niż 7 dni kalendarzowych, licząc od dnia następującego po dniu przekazania zamówienia Wykonawcy. Termin realizacji dostawy jednostkowej stanowi kryterium oceny ofert, zgodnie z zasadami określonymi w Rozdziale SWZ dotyczącym kryteriów oceny ofert. 3. Wykonawcy przysługiwać będzie wynagrodzenie wyłącznie za rzeczywiście zamówiony, dostarczony i odebrany przez Zamawiającego asortyment, według cen jednostkowych wynikających z umowy. Ilości asortymentu wskazane w formularzach asortymentowo-cenowych mają charakter szacunkowy i zostały określone na podstawie przewidywanego zapotrzebowania Zamawiającego w okresie obowiązywania umowy. 4. Zamawiający, na podstawie art. 441 ustawy Pzp, zastrzega sobie możliwość skorzystania z prawa opcji polegającego na zwiększeniu zakresu zamówienia na następujących zasadach: 1) Zamawiający może skorzystać z prawa opcji w przypadku wystąpienia w okresie obowiązywania umowy zwiększonego zapotrzebowania na asortyment objęty daną częścią zamówienia w stosunku do zapotrzebowania przyjętego dla zamówienia podstawowego, pod warunkiem posiadania środków finansowych na realizację zwiększonego zakresu zamówienia; 2) maksymalna wartość świadczeń realizowanych w ramach prawa opcji nie przekroczy 50% wartości brutto zamówienia podstawowego określonej w umowie dla danej części zamówienia; 3) prawo opcji może obejmować całość lub wybrane pozycje asortymentowe objęte daną częścią zamówienia; 4) skorzystanie z prawa opcji nastąpi poprzez złożenie Wykonawcy przez Zamawiającego jednostronnego oświadczenia o skorzystaniu z prawa opcji lub poprzez złożenie zamówienia jednostkowego ze wskazaniem, że jest ono realizowane w ramach prawa opcji. Skorzystanie z prawa opcji nie wymaga zawarcia aneksu do umowy; 5) Zamawiający może korzystać z prawa opcji jednokrotnie lub wielokrotnie w okresie obowiązywania umowy, z zastrzeżeniem, że łączna wartość świadczeń zrealizowanych w ramach prawa opcji nie może przekroczyć limitu określonego w pkt 2; 6) dostawy realizowane w ramach prawa opcji będą wykonywane na takich samych warunkach jak dostawy w ramach zamówienia podstawowego, w szczególności w zakresie sposobu składania zamówień, terminów dostaw, miejsca dostawy, zasad odbioru, odpowiedzialności Wykonawcy oraz warunków płatności; 7) ceny jednostkowe asortymentu dostarczanego w ramach prawa opcji będą odpowiadały cenom jednostkowym obowiązującym na podstawie umowy w chwili złożenia zamówienia w ramach prawa opcji.

Zamawiający, na podstawie art. 441 ustawy Pzp, zastrzega sobie możliwość skorzystania z prawa opcji polegającego na zwiększeniu zakresu zamówienia na następujących zasadach: 1) Zamawiający może skorzystać z prawa opcji w przypadku wystąpienia w okresie obowiązywania umowy zwiększonego zapotrzebowania na asortyment objęty daną częścią zamówienia w stosunku do zapotrzebowania przyjętego dla zamówienia podstawowego, pod warunkiem posiadania środków finansowych na realizację zwiększonego zakresu zamówienia; 2) maksymalna wartość świadczeń realizowanych w ramach prawa opcji nie przekroczy 50% wartości brutto zamówienia podstawowego określonej w umowie dla danej części zamówienia; 3) prawo opcji może obejmować całość lub wybrane pozycje asortymentowe objęte daną częścią zamówienia; 4) skorzystanie z prawa opcji nastąpi poprzez złożenie Wykonawcy przez Zamawiającego jednostronnego oświadczenia o skorzystaniu z prawa opcji lub poprzez złożenie zamówienia jednostkowego ze wskazaniem, że jest ono realizowane w ramach prawa opcji. Skorzystanie z prawa opcji nie wymaga zawarcia aneksu do umowy; 5) Zamawiający może korzystać z prawa opcji jednokrotnie lub wielokrotnie w okresie obowiązywania umowy, z zastrzeżeniem, że łączna wartość świadczeń zrealizowanych w ramach prawa opcji nie może przekroczyć limitu określonego w pkt 2; 6) dostawy realizowane w ramach prawa opcji będą wykonywane na takich samych warunkach jak dostawy w ramach zamówienia podstawowego, w szczególności w zakresie sposobu składania zamówień, terminów dostaw, miejsca dostawy, zasad odbioru, odpowiedzialności Wykonawcy oraz warunków płatności; 7) ceny jednostkowe asortymentu dostarczanego w ramach prawa opcji będą odpowiadały cenom jednostkowym obowiązującym na podstawie umowy w chwili złożenia zamówienia w ramach prawa opcji.

Predmetom zákazky je taktiež aj informačná kampaň realizovaná pred zavedením systému, počas jeho zavádzania, aj po jeho zavedení, s cieľom informovať obyvateľstvo. De raamovereenkomst wordt afgesloten voor de duur van 4 jaar. Deze raamovereenkomst heeft als doel te voorzien in: Deel 1: Wettelijk verplicht onderhoud - uitgevoerd door het eigen personeel van de opdrachtnemer (met de vereiste erkenningen) of erkende keuringsorganismes. - een jaarlijks nazicht van de stooktoestellen op stookolie en op gasvormige brandstoffen. - voor de koeltoestellen zal de dienstverlener ervoor zorgen dat de verplichtingen inzake onderhoud en nazicht worden nageleefd. - de dienstverlener staat in voor een dichtheidsmeting van de gasleidingen. Deel 2: Preventief onderhoud - bijkomend onderhoud bovenop de wettelijke vereisten, dat op regelmatige tijdstippen of op basis van de bedrijfsuren dient te gebeuren met als doel: - het bevorderen van de levensduur van de installaties; - het voorkomen van gevaarlijke toestanden; - het voorkomen van storingen en defecten; - het energieverbruik zo laag mogelijk te houden. Deel 3: Correctief onderhoud - onderhoud dat uitgevoerd wordt wanneer defecten zich voordoen: - storingen en defecten herstellen binnen de overeengekomen tijd; - de prijs voor de wisselstukken wordt bepaald op basis van een verhogingspercentage; Deel 4: Deelopdrachten - uitvoeren van werken in het kader van afbraak, vernieuwing en/of uitbreiding van technische installaties: - per deelopdracht wordt een afzonderlijk dienstbevel gegeven, waarbij aard en omvang van de werken, aanvangsdatum en uitvoeringstermijn worden opgegeven. Een eigen pv van vaststelling voor aanvaarding van de werken van de deelopdracht (deel-oplevering) zal worden opgemaakt, conform de bepalingen van dit bestek; - op basis van een prijs per uur voor de werkuren; - de prijs voor de nodige materialen wordt bepaald op basis van een verhogingspercentage; - er kan geen minimum aantal werkuren noch een minimum bedrag aan deelopdrachten bepaald worden. Deel 5: Wisselstukken op basis van een verhogingspercentage - het bedrag dat jaarlijks wordt voorzien voor de nodige wisselstukken (preventief onderhoud, correctief onderhoud en deelopdrachten) wordt vastgelegd op € 100 000 exclusief btw. De combinatie van deze interventies heeft als doel: - het bewerkstelligen van de bedrijfszekerheid; - het garanderen van een veilige werking; - Het voorkomen van gevaarlijke situaties; - Het bevorderen van de levensduur van de technische installaties, d.w.z. er voor zorgen dat de installaties, gezien vanuit economische en/of technische overwegingen, zo lang mogelijk meegaan; - Het materiaal behoeden voor beschadiging; - Het voorkomen van storingen en defecten; - Het herstellen van defecten; - Het energieverbruik te minimaliseren; - Plaatsen en in dienst stellen van bijkomende HVAC-installaties via deelopdrachten.

Nota conceptuală aprobată de CN APM reprezintă document de intrare în contract. Elaborarea Studiului de Fezabilitate va începe după aprobarea Temei de proiectare de către CN APM. Prestarea serviciilor se va realiza ținând cont de o serie de cerințe specifice, detaliate la nivelul Caietului de sarcini nr 41932/04.11.2026. Întrucât în urma clonării prezentei documentații de atribuire, SEAP nu mai permite deschiderea secțiunilor IV.4.1 Modul de prezentare al propunerii tehnice și IV.4.2 Modul de prezentare al propunerii financiare și întrucât conținutul acestora a suferit modificări în urma măsurilor de remediere aplicate Documetației de atribuire conform Avizului nr. 13416/DGEDACMISP/15.10.2026 iar secțiunea III.1.3.a) Capacitatea tehnica si/sau profesională, permite introducerea unui număr limitat de caractere, Entitatea contractantă publică Fișa de date a achiziției în secțiunea Documente atasate ce compun Documentatia de Atribuire. Obiectivul se realizează prin dezvoltarea unor soluții digitale pentru serviciile publice locale – servicii de e-guvernare și servicii digitale noi, accesibile nemijlocit cetățenilor.În ceea ce privește necesitatea la nivelul comunei, echipamentele prezente sunt neschimbate de ani de zile și nu acoperă numărul angajaților care au nevoie de acestea, astfel muncă acestora desfășurându-se pe hârtie, fiind nevoie de spații fizice de stocare în ceea ce privește lucrul cu cetățenii căutarea și documentarea la nivelul instituției necesitând mai mult timp din cauza procesului anevoios. Die Ausschreibung ist in fünf Lose unterteilt: - Los 1: Katzen - Los 2: Hunde - Los 3: Kleintiere - Los 4: Transporte und Kadaverbergungen - Los 5: Reptilien, Amphibien, Insekten, Vögel und Spinnentiere Die Leistungen umfassen insbesondere die artgerechte Unterbringung und Versorgung der Fundtiere sowie deren Vermittlung, soweit diese Gegenstand des jeweiligen Loses sind.
